feed.summary: Shares of Impinj, Power Integrations, Kulicke and Soffa, Microchip Technology, and Monolithic Power Systems jumped after weaker-than-expected U.S. employment data cooled Treasury yields, easing interest rate pressure. feed.title: Walmart shoppers warned as nationwide pasta recall expands over Listeria concerns
feed.summary: Gias Foods, Inc. has expanded a recall of its Bettergoods brand Authentic Italian Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine due to potential Listeria contamination, affecting all lot codes distributed nationwide to Walmart stores. The FDA has designated this a Class I recall, indicating serious health risks, and advises consumers to return the product for a refund. This recall comes amid heightened concerns over foodborne illnesses, with other recent large-scale recalls involving salmonella and cyclospora.

feed.title: The employer imperative: Addressing the unmet needs of employees with cancer
feed.summary: This article emphasizes the growing need for employers to support employees facing cancer, as more individuals are diagnosed at working age. It highlights that many employees with cancer miss essential preventive screenings and mental health care, often unaware of available employer resources. The piece urges employers to improve support by clarifying preventive care benefits, strengthening mental health services, and promoting comprehensive cancer care resources.

feed.title: Disney cuts 300 workers, offers executives early retirement
feed.summary: Walt Disney Co. recently laid off nearly 300 workers, primarily in human resources and technology, as part of an industry-wide consolidation and a "One Disney" restructuring effort led by CEO Josh D’Amaro. The company is also offering early retirement packages to older executives and plans further cuts, particularly in the television division, to adapt to changing consumption patterns and improve efficiency. This move reflects a broader trend of workforce reductions across Hollywood studios as the streaming market matures and cost-cutting becomes a priority.
